svg.title: From a building request to a verified construction
svg.desc: The coordinator asks the Architect for a drawing. Code validates it and computes materials; invalid drawings return feedback. A saved blueprint reference and material bill inform the planner. The action agent gathers resources and invokes an algorithmic Builder, which verifies the placed blocks and reports its result.
